buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC):

CNAI (W) Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: NAI (Karwar) and NAD (Karwar) 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Other conditions to be abided by the contractor : (a) The Contract firm are to be abide by the general rules in force by the management of the Navy including Official Secret Act 1923. (b) All types of photogra phy is prohibited. Smart phone/devices banned inside Naval base. Defaulter’s gadget will be seized and ne cessary legal action will be initiated. (c) All types of sketch, information, plan, model, note, photographs, video graphs, movement of ships/submarines, collection or publication or communication related to defen ce/ Naval service with any unauthorized/ foreign personnel are considered unauthorized. (d) All data, doc uments, materials and information received or generated during the execution of contracts to be treated a s confidential or restricted unless otherwise specified. (e) No unauthorized disclosure of information or doc uments related to contract shall be made to any person or entity not officially entitled to receive such info rmation. 2. Interest free advance payment of 15% of total order value (Exclusive Taxes and Duties) will be payabl e to the firm upon submission of 15% APBG. 3. Part supply, Part payment will be applicable. 4. 100% payment will be made by PCDA (Navy)/ CDA (Navy) upon acceptance of service/ product. 5. The seller has go through fitment and functional trials (FFT) to be carried out onboard/ test assembly o n 02 nos randomly selected samples of spares of each component for the items listed in enclosure I (Copy is uploaded in the bid at buyer added specific ATC). 6. All inspection activities pertaining to raw material and end store under procurement to be undertake n as per latest approved QAP document for IRL system (DOC No. QAP-262-S067495.S067496 and S067493 R00 dated 23 Oct 21) and latest approved ATPs by CNAI (W). 7. The spares supplied by supplier should be current and of latest design/ drawings and should cater des ign improvements/ modifications (if any) being incorporated to the system as a result of product improvem ent. 8. Buyer can terminate the contract in full/ part without furnishing any reason at any time. 9. Warranty shall be 1 year from the date of delivery of the goods. . 4.
